claims.evidence: The report shows a LUMIX mirrorless camera but does not read the model G7 from the top plate or charger.
The report shows the camera body and lens but does not establish cosmetic condition or wear.
The report shows a charger and one battery beside it; a second battery is not shown.
No location is visible in the photos.

risks.risk: Camera does not turn on or functions are faulty
risks.proof: Video clip of the camera powering on, navigating menus, taking a picture, and reviewing it.

risks.risk: Shutter count or usage history is high or unknown
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of the shutter count / usage information screen.

risks.risk: Image sensor is dirty or damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the sensor with the lens removed, or a shot of a white wall at a small aperture.

risks.risk: Lens glass has scratches, fungus, or haze
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements under light.

risks.risk: Battery health is poor or dead
risks.proof: Video of the battery holding a charge or being charged by the charger.
Video of the charger indicator light working with a battery inserted.

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as caps, strap, box, or manuals
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories laid out together.
Close-up photos of seams, screws, and body for repair marks, plus any receipts.

proof_requests: Photo of the top plate showing the model number to confirm G7.
Video of the camera turning on and taking a photo.
Close-up photos of the lens front and rear elements.
Photo of all batteries, charger, caps, strap, and box together.
response.reason: The witness identifies a LUMIX mirrorless camera, so a worst-case price is possible; unproven model, functions, and accessories are listed as risks with proof that would raise the value.
